Rina (CS): Quick triage from onboarding calls 2: two repeat signals that look like renewal risk if we don't act: 1) customers asking for a line-item map: route -> tokens -> cost (procurement wants this), 2) intermittent embedding latency spikes that degrade search UX. Looping @Omar (PM) @Diego (SRE).

Priya (Onboarding): Seen this across 3 pilots this week. They specifically want a CSV export that ties route names to cost columns.

Nate (AM): Buyer on the renewal call said: "we can't sign unless finance can see per-feature costs". I'll get the invoice example.

signal-bot: New signal captured: "route cost export requested" (id=12345).

Diego (SRE): For embedding latency I can run traces for the affected tenants. Suspect KV cache TTL / small batch sizes causing cold-start spikes.

Omar (PM): Proposed plan:
- Short-term (this sprint): produce a sample CSV export + one-page explainer for AMs; run focused embedding perf tests on flagged accounts.
- Mid-term (Q2): product work: console view for per-route consumption & cost, and embedding latency SLO charts/alerts.

Omar (PM): Owners: @Nate (customer comms + invoice sample), @Priya (AM enablement one-pager), @Diego (perf profiling, 2-4h). I'll add a triage card and peg billing visibility for next roadmap sync.

Nate (AM): I'll pull the invoice and build the CSV mapping today; adding ARR + renewal date to the triage card.

Priya (Onboarding): I'll make a 1-slide how-to + checklist for AMs to share with customers.

Diego (SRE): Starting perf traces now. If it's KV TTL I can propose a config tweak for quick rollout; will post results here.

Rina (CS): Added to CS signals board: https://redwood.internal/cs-signals/3950012345. Marked per-route visibility as P0 for the two at-risk renewals. Please drop links to artifacts in this thread when ready. :memo:
